ns2:section.sectionText: Field trip to Ecuador is from July 9 to July 27. Field work exposes students to topics in ecology, evolution, and organismal biology in Amazonian Ecuador. Course work includes lectures, student presentations and written reports, daily field trips with guides, and student-guided research projects. Prerequisite: consent of instructor. Contact Kevin Dixon for more information regarding this course at kdixon@life.uiuc.edu or 244-7350. 3 hours
